standard_prerequisites.name: The notion of a Lie algebra being inner over an extension L, and the star-action of Gal(L/Q) compared with the star-action of Gal(C/R)

standard_prerequisites.name: The Tits algebra D(Lie G, Q)(lambda) and the statement that its centre is the minimal extension over which the algebra becomes inner
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The author's proposition labelled Beta=D at source lines 393-406, used inside the counted proof
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the centre of the division algebra with the minimal splitting extension and lets the proof conclude that it is imaginary quadratic.

core_obligations: Reduce to the non-inner case: if the algebra is already inner the conclusions are obvious, so assume it is not and let L be the unique minimal extension over which it becomes inner (proof lines 478-480).

Choose a weight moved by the Galois action: take a dominant weight lambda that is not fixed by any nontrivial element of Gal(L/Q), and use the author's proposition on the Tits algebra to identify L with the centre of D(Lie G, Q)(lambda) and with the division algebra condition (proof lines 481-484).
Show L is imaginary quadratic: since L is not Q, these identifications force it to be an imaginary quadratic extension of Q (proof lines 484-485).

Match the star-actions: every Gal(C/R)-invariant dominant weight is shown to be Gal(L/Q)-invariant, by replacing lambda with a suitable positive multiple so that it lies in the root lattice, using the author's remark on the root-lattice case and the author's fourth description of R-universality to reach a contradiction with the Tits-algebra identification if it were not (proof lines 486-493).
proof_roadmap: 除掉已经 inner 的平凡情形，取使代数变 inner 的最小扩张 L，再取不被 Gal(L/Q) 任何非平凡元固定的支配权 lambda。
由作者的 Tits 代数命题把 L 认成 D(Lie G, Q)(lambda) 的中心并得到除代数条件，从而 L 必是虚二次扩张。
最后证明每个 Gal(C/R)-不变的支配权也 Gal(L/Q)-不变：把它换成落在根格的适当正整数倍，由根格情形的注记与 R-universality 的第四条等价描述推出矛盾。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the structural lemma on the minimal extension over which an R-universal semisimple Lie algebra becomes inner (author lemma at source lines 470-475, label SameFixed). The proof (source lines 477-493) is a two-step argument: it first identifies the minimal extension with the centre of a Tits algebra computed at a weight moved by the Galois action and deduces that it is imaginary quadratic (proof lines 478-485), and then shows that the star-action of Gal(L/Q) agrees with that of Gal(C/R) by reducing an arbitrary invariant weight to the root lattice and invoking the author's fourth description of R-universality (proof lines 486-493). The lemma is what makes condition (2) of the author's direct-sum criterion meaningful, and the proof uses two different earlier statements of the paper rather than a citation. H2.
